entries.title: Spirehold opens its gates
items: Found a city that grows by itself and hold its walls against ever bigger sieges.
Nine kinds of tower, each with two choices of path at levels 10 and 30, and damage that doubles every 25 levels.
Cast Fireball, Chain Lightning, Frost Bloom, Meteor, Earthshake, Aegis Ward, Arcane Barrage and Skyfall — or let apprentices cast them for you.

Hire court mages who cast on their own, and adventuring parties who stop at the tavern. Send heroes on quests from five minutes to eight hours: win and they bring back gold, lore, starshards and relics; lose and they come home empty-handed.
Leave it running on another screen, or close it: the city keeps earning while you are away.
From wave 100, found a city in a new realm and earn Crowns for bonuses that last forever.
